item.title: Downtown Santa Monica to Host St. Paddy's Day Celebration on Third Street Promenade
item.description: Free St. Patrick's Day celebration on Third Street Promenade in Santa Monica March 14, 2026, 6-9pm featuring live Irish music, games, and outdoor bar.

item.title: Newsletter: Mar 02, 2026
item.description: Yes, it's already March.. Mostly sunny. Winds SSW at 5 to 10 mph.Today: 🌤️ High 69° / Low 53°Tomorrow: 🌤️ High 66° / Low 54°First Up Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District headquarters where board members are reviewing new immigration enforcement policies

item.title: MSNOW Reporter Jacob Soboroff to Discuss New Book on Los Angeles Fires at Santa Monica Library
item.description: MSNBC reporter Jacob Soboroff discusses his book 'Firestorm' about the 2025 LA fires at Santa Monica Library March 4, 6pm. Free event, book required.

item.title: California Lawmakers Introduce Bipartisan Bill to End Insurance Delays for Rare Disease Patients
item.description: California lawmakers introduce bipartisan AB 1887 to eliminate prior authorization and step therapy requirements for FDA-approved rare disease treatments

item.title: Santa Monica Girl, 11, Builds 3D Printing Business
item.description: Aria Mendoza, 11, of Santa Monica built Print Love by Aria from cardboard keychain sales, now has 40,000 TikTok followers and donates profits to charity.

item.title: Kamasi Washington to Headline Inaugural Santa Monica International Jazz Festival in May
item.description: Kamasi Washington headlines the inaugural Santa Monica International Jazz Festival May 1-9, 2026, curated by Stanley Clarke with performances at Tongva Park and BroadStage.

item.title: California Expands State-Backed Mortgage Assistance for LA Fire Survivors
item.description: California expanded CalAssist Mortgage Fund for LA Fire survivors: up to $100,000 for 12 months of payments, increased income limits to $281,400.

item.title: Zbur Introduces Bill to Strengthen Protections for Youth in Foster Care
item.description: California Assemblymember Rick Chavez Zbur introduces AB 1967 to strengthen protections for youth in foster care ages 18-21 and require 21-day review of abuse reports.

item.title: Malibu Council Takes First Step to Speed Rebuilding for Palisades Fire Victims
item.description: Malibu City Council votes 5-0 to streamline seawall variances for 320+ beachfront properties damaged in Palisades Fire, allowing faster rebuilding.
